mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ebook_snapshot ( id, ebook_id, `date`, view_count, vote_count, view_increase, vote_increase ) VALUES ( #{snapshot.id}, #{snapshot.ebookId}, #{snapshot.date}, #{snapshot.viewCount}, #{snapshot.voteCount}, #{snapshot.viewIncrease}, #{snapshot.voteIncrease} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = VALUES(view_count), vote_count = VALUES(vote_count), view_increase = VALUES(view_increase), vote_increase = VALUES(vote_increase)
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(view_count), 0) AS viewCount, IFNULL(SUM(vote_count), 0) AS voteCount, GREATEST(IFNULL(SUM(view_increase), 0), 0) AS todayViewCount, GREATEST(IFNULL(SUM(vote_increase), 0), 0) AS todayVoteCount FROM ebook_snapshot WHERE `date` = CURDATE()

SELECT `date`, IFNULL(SUM(view_count), 0) AS viewCount, IFNULL(SUM(vote_count), 0) AS voteCount, GREATEST(IFNULL(SUM(view_increase), 0), 0) AS viewIncrease, GREATEST(IFNULL(SUM(vote_increase), 0), 0) AS voteIncrease FROM ebook_snapshot WHERE `date` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) GROUP BY `date` ORDER BY `date`
